INS 330.name: Citric Acid
INS 330.explanation: Used to provide a sour taste and help control acidity in foods.
INS 330.common_uses: Soft drinks, candies, sauces and packaged foods.

INS 322.name: Lecithin
INS 322.explanation: Helps ingredients such as oil and water mix together.
INS 322.common_uses: Chocolate, baked goods and processed foods.

INS 500.name: Sodium Bicarbonate
INS 500.explanation: Helps dough and baked products rise.

INS 471.name: Mono- and Diglycerides of Fatty Acids
INS 471.explanation: Helps maintain texture and keep ingredients mixed.
INS 471.common_uses: Bread, cakes, spreads and processed foods.

INS 202.name: Potassium Sorbate
INS 202.explanation: Used to help prevent the growth of certain molds and yeasts.
INS 202.common_uses: Beverages, sauces, cheese and packaged foods.

INS 211.name: Sodium Benzoate
INS 211.explanation: Used to help preserve certain acidic foods and beverages.
INS 211.common_uses: Soft drinks, sauces and packaged foods.
